title: Yaara Consultancy Services — AI image generation manifest
description: One entry per image slot on the website. Generate each image with an AI image tool (Midjourney, DALL·E, Flux, Ideogram, etc.), then overwrite the file at the listed path in the project. The site picks up the new artwork automatically — no code change is needed. File paths are relative to the project root.
howToUse: 1. Copy the `prompt` for an image into your AI image generator.
2. Set the output size to the listed `width` x `height` (or the closest supported aspect ratio).
3. Export as PNG, named exactly as in `file`, and replace the placeholder at that path.
4. Keep the `negativePrompt` (or append it with --no / negative prompt field if your tool supports one).
5. Do not add any legible text inside images — labels are rendered by the website, not the artwork.

styleGuide.summary: Editorial flat vector illustration for a premium Indian accounting & compliance consultancy. Calm, trustworthy, hand-crafted feel — like Stripe's brand illustrations, but warmer.
styleGuide.globalStyleTokens: flat editorial illustration, clean vector shapes, soft rounded geometry, subtle paper-grain texture, generous negative space, warm natural light, Indian small-business context, premium and calm, matte colours
styleGuide.globalNegativePrompt: photorealistic people, stock photo look, 3D render gloss, neon colours, legible text, letters, numbers, watermark, logo, busy clutter, dramatic shadows, lens flare, distorted hands, deformed faces
styleGuide.notes: Human figures may appear but must be stylised and faceless or softly abstracted (illustration style), never photorealistic. Navy should dominate; gold is an accent (roughly 85/15). Backgrounds must be the warm paper tone (#FAF7F1) or the light surface tone (#F2EFE7) so the artwork blends with the website.

images.alt: Editorial illustration of six different Indian businesses — a startup desk, a freelancer, a shop counter, a clinic, a community trust and a small factory — connected by one ledger
images.prompt: Flat editorial vector illustration, wide composition: six small vignettes of Indian businesses arranged in a gentle arc — a founder's desk with a laptop and incorporation certificate, a freelancer at a home studio, a kirana shop counter with a ledger, a doctor's clinic desk, a community trust office with donation receipts, and a small factory with crates. All six connected by a single flowing gold ledger line that sweeps across the composition. Deep navy (#0E2A47) dominant with muted gold (#B8873B) accents, warm paper background (#FAF7F1), soft paper-grain texture, stylised faceless figures, generous negative space, premium calm editorial mood.
